tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search and list issues for a Sentry organization. Supports Sentry search syntax in the query parameter (e.g., "is:unresolved", "assigned:me", "level:error", "first-seen:-24h"). Filter by project IDs, environment, and time range. Results are paginated with a cursor.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Sentry issue by its ID. Returns title, status, priority, event count, user count, assigned user, and more.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Update an issue's attributes. Supports changing status (resolve, unresolve, ignore), assigning to a user or team, bookmarking, and marking as seen. Only specified fields are modified.

tools.name: list_issue_events
tools.description: List the events (occurrences) for a specific Sentry issue. Each event represents a single occurrence of the issue with its own stack trace, tags, and context.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get full details of a specific event including stack trace, breadcrumbs, tags, context, and more. Requires the project slug and event ID.

tools.name: list_issue_tags
tools.description: List tag distributions for a Sentry issue. Shows which browsers, operating systems, releases, environments, and other tags are associated with the issue, along with the top values and their counts.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List comments (notes) on a Sentry issue. Returns the activity feed filtered to user-posted comments. Use create_comment to add a new comment.

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Add a comment (note) to a Sentry issue. The comment is posted as the authenticated user.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all projects for the current Sentry organization. Returns project name, slug, platform, and access status. Use the project slug for filtering issues or retrieving events.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Sentry project by its slug. Returns platform, status, date created, and access information.

tools.name: get_project_keys
tools.description: List client keys (DSNs) for a Sentry project. The DSN is needed to initialize the Sentry SDK in your application. Returns the public DSN, key name, and active status.

tools.name: list_project_environments
tools.description: List environments for a Sentry project. Returns environment names and visibility status. Use the project slug from list_projects.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List all Sentry organizations the current user belongs to. Returns org name, slug, and status.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Get detailed information about the current Sentry organization including name, slug, and status.

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List all members of the current Sentry organization. Returns name, email, role, and join date for each member.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List all teams in the current Sentry organization. Returns team name, slug, member count, and creation date.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: List releases for the current Sentry organization. Optionally filter by project ID(s). Returns version, release date, new issue count, commit count, and deploy count.

tools.name: get_release
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific release, including commit count, deploy count, authors, and first/last event timestamps.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: List alert rules for the current Sentry organization. Returns alert name, status, type, and associated project.

tools.name: list_monitors
tools.description: List cron monitors for the current Sentry organization. Monitors track scheduled jobs (crons) and alert when check-ins are missed or fail.

tools.name: list_replays
tools.description: List session replays for the current Sentry organization. Replays capture user browser sessions including DOM interactions, console logs, and network requests.
